statement: ∀ (b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V), (∀ i, b i = e y v i.val) → ∀ (z : V) (μ : ℂ), h z = μ • z → (∀ i : Index lam, μ ≠ (((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ))) → z = 0
proof:
classical
intro b hb z μ hz hμ
have heig : ∀ i : Index lam,
    h (b i) = (((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)) • b i := by
  intro i
  rw [hb]
  exact (h_T002 i).2
have hmap : h z = ∑ k : Index lam,
    (b.repr z k * (((lam - 2 * (k.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ))) • b k := by
  calc
    h z = h (∑ k : Index lam, b.repr z k • b k) := by rw [b.sum_repr]
    _ = _ := by simp only [map_sum, map_smul, heig, smul_smul]
apply b.repr.injective
ext i
have hi := congrArg (fun w : V => b.repr w i) hz
have hi' : b.repr z i * (((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)) = μ * b.repr z i := by
  rw [hmap] at hi
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply,
    Module.Basis.repr_self_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hi
  simpa using hi
have hc : b.repr z i = 0 := by
  have hm : ( (((lam - 2 * (i.val : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℂ)) - μ) * b.repr z i = 0 := by
    linear_combination hi'
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hm).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hμ i).symm)
simpa using hc

@checked : ∀ {V : Type} [instVAdd : AddCommGroup V] [instVMod : _root_.Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (K : Type)
  [instK : Field K] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  0 ≤ lam ∧ lam < ↑p →
    Module.Finite ℂ V ∧
        Module.finrank ℂ V = (lam + 1).toNat ∧
          h * x - x * h = 2 • x ∧ h * y - y * h = -2 • y ∧ x * y - y * x = h ∧ Highest lam x h ∧ Simple x y h →
      Lowering lam x y h v →
        (∀ (i : Index lam), e y v ↑i ≠ 0 ∧ h (e y v ↑i) = ↑(lam - 2 * ↑↑i) • e y v ↑i) →
          ∀ (b : Module.Basis (Index lam) ℂ V),
            (∀ (i : Index lam), b i = e y v ↑i) →
              ∀ (z : V) (μ : ℂ), h z = μ • z → (∀ (i : Index lam), μ ≠ ↑(lam - 2 * ↑↑i)) → z = 0
